replacements.old: The Twilight universe is returning — not as a reboot of the original films, but as something far more intriguing: an animated series on Netflix based on Stephenie Meyer's 2020 companion novel Midnight Sun. Netflix gave the project a straight-to-series order, meaning there's no pilot phase — they're committed.
replacements.new: The Twilight universe is returning — not as a reboot of the original films, but as an animated series on Netflix based on Stephenie Meyer's 2020 companion novel Midnight Sun. Netflix announced the project as an animated series in development in September 2024; there is still no official release date.

replacements.old:
• Aug 2020
    Stephenie Meyer publishes Midnight Sun — the novel immediately hits #1 worldwide and sells millions of copies, proving insatiable demand for more Twilight content.
  • Apr 2023
    Lionsgate Television announces the project is in early development. Fans erupt globally — the hashtag #MidnightSunNetflix trends on Twitter/X within hours.
  • Mar 2024
    Lionsgate vice chairman Michael Burns confirms the adaptation will be an animated series, not a live-action reboot. This creative choice surprises many but excites animation fans.
  • Late 2024
    Netflix acquires the project and grants a straight-to-series order. Sinead Daly (Tell Me Lies, The Walking Dead: World Beyond) is announced as writer and executive producer.
  • Jan 2026
    Netflix confirms the show is actively in production development. No release date announced. Stephenie Meyer confirmed as executive producer alongside Meghan Hibbett of Fickle Fish Films.
  • Jul 2026
    Casting officially underway. A production casting sheet confirms voice casting is happening for Jacob Black and Billy Black, with production dates tentatively running August 2026 through May 2027, based out of Los Angeles. This is the first concrete production timeline the show has had.
replacements.new:
• Aug 2020
    Stephenie Meyer publishes Midnight Sun, her Edward-Cullen perspective retelling of the first Twilight story.
  • Sep 2024
    Netflix officially announces an animated adaptation of Midnight Sun, with Stephenie Meyer serving as an executive producer and Sinead Daly writing and executive producing.
  • Apr 2025
    Netflix includes The Twilight Saga: Midnight Sun among its upcoming book-to-screen adaptations, describing it as an animated series based on Meyer's novel.
  • Jul 2026
    New casting update. A production casting report says voice casting is underway for Jacob Black and Billy Black, with tentative production dates of August 2026 through May 2027 in Los Angeles. Netflix has not announced a public release date.

replacements.old: Update, July 2026: Netflix has confirmed voice casting is underway for two roles — Jacob Black and Billy Black — with production dates tentatively set from August 2026 through May 2027. This is the first real, concrete casting news the project has had since it was announced. No names have leaked yet for either role.

No actor names have been publicly announced for either role. Netflix has not announced an official release date.

replacements.new: Notably, Edward and Bella have not been mentioned in the reported casting round. That does not establish who will voice them or how the series will structure its early episodes, so we are treating those roles as unannounced rather than speculating about casting plans.

replacements.old: Pattinson is currently attached to multiple major projects including Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey and The Batman: Part II. His schedule makes a full voice-acting commitment to a multi-episode animated series challenging, though not impossible. He has not publicly commented on whether he'd return to the Twilight universe.
replacements.new: There is currently no official announcement that Robert Pattinson will voice Edward Cullen in the animated series. Unless Netflix or the producers announce otherwise, the voice cast for Edward remains unconfirmed.

replacements.old: Stewart, speaking at the Palm Springs Film Festival in early 2026, expressed openness to returning to the Twilight universe in some capacity. She has previously spoken warmly about the saga's impact on her career. Her involvement as Bella — even in a supporting capacity given the Edward-focused POV — seems more plausible than Pattinson's.
replacements.new: There is currently no official announcement that Kristen Stewart will voice Bella Swan in the animated series. Bella's voice casting remains unannounced, so claims about a return should be treated as speculation until Netflix or the producers confirm it.

replacements.old: Update, July 2026: With production dates now tentatively confirmed for August 2026 through May 2027, and animation typically requiring another 12–18 months of post-production after voice/production work wraps, a late 2027 premiere is possible but 2028 is now looking more likely. Netflix has still not announced an official release date.
replacements.new: Update, July 2026: Netflix has still not announced an official release date. A July 2026 production casting report lists tentative production dates from August 2026 through May 2027, but that schedule does not establish a Netflix premiere date. A late-2027 or 2028 release is a reasonable industry estimate, not a confirmed window.

replacements.old: Netflix has been tight-lipped, which typically means the project is still in its early creative phase. The good news: Netflix gave it a straight-to-series order rather than developing a pilot first, which signals genuine confidence in the project — and the confirmed casting timeline is the clearest sign yet that this is moving forward for real.
